custom_logic_notes: This is a hedging EA that opens opposing positions (BUY and SELL simultaneously or sequentially) on the same symbol. The core logic involves: 1) Opening an initial position in one direction, 2) If price moves against the position, opening a hedge (opposite direction) position, 3) Managing the net exposure and closing both sides when the combined profit reaches a target. The EA uses OrderSend with MqlTradeRequest/MqlTradeResult for execution. Position counting and net profit calculation across long and short positions are central to the logic. No technical indicators are used for entry signals - the hedging mechanism itself is the strategy.
python_conversion_notes: Hedging logic requires a backtesting framework that supports simultaneous long and short positions on the same asset (e.g., not standard event-driven frameworks that assume netting). Must track individual positions with separate PnL. Position netting and hedge-profit-close logic must be reimplemented carefully. No indicator computation needed - conversion is purely order management logic. Consider using a custom Position class to track each open trade individually and compute net/hedge PnL across opposing positions.
